newsitem.title: USA: Student kills counselor at Purdue University.
newsitem.headline: Student kills counselor at Purdue University.

text.p: A student accused by an upperclassman-counsellor of cocaine possession shot and killed the counsellor in a dormitory at Purdue University on Wednesday, a university spokesman said.
The student was holed up inside his room at the dormitory, Wiley Hall, in a stand-off with police after the incident, the spokesman said.

Witnesses said a SWAT team surrounded the building, which houses 750 students and is located about a block from Purdue's football stadium. The building was evacuated and the situation is "under control" for the moment, the university said.
The university information office said the counsellor discovered on Tuesday that the student who did the shooting had cocaine.
Campus police searched the student's room and car and confirmed the report, but the student was not arrested.
"The student allegedly came into Wiley Hall with a shotgun today and killed the counsellor," a school spokesman said.
The names and ages of the student and the victim were not available.
